name: prtfl-next
description: Next.js port of the Tobiloba Odu portfolio. Runs alongside the Gatsby site until parity.

comments.deps: next-sanity is deliberately NOT used. Its peers on `sanity` and `styled-components` are not optional, so it would pull the whole Studio into this app for features we do not use (embedded Studio, visual editing). The Studio stays deployed separately; here we only read content, which @sanity/client does on its own.
